# External Operator Guidance (Non-Authoritative)

**This directory is not repository policy.**

Nothing under `.agent/external/` overrides `AGENTS.md`, `.agent/rules/`, skills, workflows, or
domain docs. These files are optional defaults for humans configuring agent providers **outside**
the repository.

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [`global-principles.md`](./global-principles.md) | Vendor-neutral cross-repository defaults |
| [`provider-integration.md`](./provider-integration.md) | Codex / Cursor consumption guide |

Required configuration for celebra-me operation lives only in the repository-owned surface
(`AGENTS.md` and `.agent/` policy trees).
